info.longName: Fidelity Enhanced U.S. All-Cap Equity ETF

funds_data.description: Normally investing at least 80% of assets in U.S. equity securities. The fund invests primarily in common stocks. Investing assets across market cap ranges in large cap, mid cap, and small cap stocks. Generally utilizing a research-driven approach identifying long-term drivers of stock returns that may include, but are not limited to, valuation, growth, quality, and other factors.
